Design:
# Design Spec: Candidate Search Filter

## Overview
Add a search filter bar to the candidate list page that filters candidates by name, skill, or status in real-time.

## Layout
- Top of the candidate list, full-width
- Search input with magnifying glass icon
- Filter dropdowns for: Skills, Status, Experience Level
- Active filter chips below the bar
- Clear all filters button

## Components Used
- TextInput — search text field
- FieldGroup — grouping the filter controls
- LiquidMetalCard — wrapping the filter bar
- Badge — active filter chips (using QUIZ_MCQ green for "active" state)

## Colors and Styling
- Search bar: bg-slate-100, border-slate-300
- Active filters: bg-green-100 text-green-800 (using QUIZ_MCQ green)
- Clear button: text-red-500 hover:text-red-700

## Interaction Behavior
- Typing triggers debounced search (300ms)
- Filter dropdowns update list immediately
- Active filters show as removable chips
- Empty state shows "No candidates match your filters" with option to c

Write complete React/TypeScript code. Run npx tsc --noEmit before finishing.
